title: Healing of a Man with Dropsy on the Sabbath
description: Jesus heals a man with dropsy on the Sabbath at the home of a leader of the Pharisees. He asks the experts in the law and the Pharisees whether it is lawful to heal on the Sabbath, but they remain silent. After the healing, Jesus justifies his action by saying that even they would pull out a son or an ox that had fallen into a well on the Sabbath.
